captaincook4d_task_graph.description: Task graph generation on CaptainCook4D: one predicted prerequisite graph per procedure from its demonstrations, scored on directed edges against the ground-truth graph. The gym scores 12 public procedures (scores_train.json / scores.json) and 12 held-out procedures (hidden test, scores_test.json); five trials per procedure, metrics averaged over trials and then over procedures. Primary metric: F1.

precision.description: Edge-level precision (%) on directed prerequisite edges after post-processing.

recall.description: Edge-level recall (%) on directed prerequisite edges after post-processing.

f1.description: Edge-level F1 (%) on directed prerequisite edges, the paper's primary benchmark metric.

worst_quartile_f1.description: Mean F1 over the weakest quarter of procedures (3 of 12): rewards methods that do not trade hard procedures for easy ones.

edge_density_ratio.description: min(|E_pred|, |E_gt|) / max(|E_pred|, |E_gt|): penalises over- and under-connected graphs.

path_coverage.description: Fraction of ground-truth source-to-sink paths whose every edge is predicted.

topological_distance.description: Fraction of ordered node pairs whose reachability (precedence) differs between predicted and ground-truth graph; lower is better.

_paper_ci90_half_width.note: Paper Table I reports 90% confidence-interval half-widths over 5 runs (all 24 procedures); they were previously stored as std_f1, which is no longer a scored metric.

captaincook4d_task_graph._note: Paper numbers are averages over all 24 CaptainCook4D procedures; the gym reports the same metrics on two fixed 12-procedure halves (public / held-out). No setup was scaled down.

noisy_demonstrations_task_graph.description: Task graph generation from noisy demonstrations (where the paper's method falls short): procedure graphs calibrated to CaptainCook4D (7-25 key-steps, ~1.23 edges per node), 4-10 demonstrations each, every key-step perturbed with probability p = 0.05 by the paper's insert/delete/replace noise model (Section IV-F3) and de-duplicated. 100 public procedures (scores_train.json) and 100 held-out procedures (hidden test). Same prediction contract, post-processing and metrics as CaptainCook4D. Primary metric: F1.

precision.description: Edge-level precision (%) on directed prerequisite edges after post-processing.

recall.description: Edge-level recall (%) on directed prerequisite edges after post-processing.

f1.description: Edge-level F1 (%) on directed prerequisite edges, the paper's primary benchmark metric.

worst_quartile_f1.description: Mean F1 over the weakest quarter of procedures (25 of 100): rewards methods that do not trade hard procedures for easy ones.

edge_density_ratio.description: min(|E_pred|, |E_gt|) / max(|E_pred|, |E_gt|): penalises over- and under-connected graphs.

path_coverage.description: Fraction of ground-truth source-to-sink paths whose every edge is predicted.

topological_distance.description: Fraction of ordered node pairs whose reachability (precedence) differs between predicted and ground-truth graph; lower is better.

noisy_demonstrations_task_graph._note: The paper reports no task-graph numbers for noisy demonstrations. These results are measured in this gym on the 100 held-out procedures (reference: the paper's DO protocol, 5 seeds; baseline: the evaluator's Count-Based), not paper numbers. The noise rate p = 0.05 was chosen on the public split by a predeclared rule (notes/hardening/noise_level_selection_40.json).
